candidate.definition_en: Made of wood; (of a person or behavior) stiff, awkward, and showing little or no emotion.
candidate.explanation_ar: مصنوع من الخشب، وتُستخدم أيضاً مجازياً لوصف الشخص أو الأداء المتخشب والجامد الخالي من التعبير.

examples: She stirred the soup with a wooden spoon.
They built a small wooden house.

senses.definition_en: Stiff and awkward in movement or manner; showing no natural emotion.
senses.explanation_ar: جامد أو متخشب في الحركة أو التعبير.
examples: His acting was rather wooden and unconvincing.
She stirred the soup with a wooden spoon.
They built a small wooden house.
His acting was rather wooden and unconvincing.
